# Monthly Imperial Strain (oe_ar_strain) relief (negative number, capped at -1.80).
# Senatorial Civil Prefectures & Dioceses grant stronger burden relief; Italia & Galliae offset Western strain.
oe_prf_strain_relief = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_mode_1 ?= 1 } add = -0.25 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_mode_1 ?= 2 } add = -0.12 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_mode_2 ?= 1 } add = -0.25 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_mode_2 ?= 2 } add = -0.12 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_mode_3 ?= 1 } add = -0.40 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_mode_3 ?= 2 } add = -0.20 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_mode_4 ?= 1 } add = -0.40 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_prf_mode_4 ?= 2 } add = -0.30 }
    add = { value = oe_prf_civil_dioceses multiply = -0.05 }
    add = { value = oe_prf_mil_dioceses multiply = -0.02 }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_prf_notitia_codified } add = -0.15 }
    min = -1.80
    max = 0
}
